controller_header.orientation: Component side facing observer; antenna up; both USB connectors down
controller_header.numbering: L/R are drawing-local row names; count 1 to 22 from antenna toward USB. Not a new connector footprint.
controller_header.evidence_kind: Visible silkscreen / row position, cross-checked against the supplier drawing; not a continuity or pad-dimension test

motor_pulldowns.status: Design value selected for direct L298 TTL inputs; actual P13 bias, power sequencing and default-off must still be verified
motor_pulldowns.datasheet_revision: DS0218 Rev 5, October 2023, Table 4 page 5 and Table 5 page 8
motor_pulldowns.calculation_limits: Uses chip table conditions and input-current magnitude for sizing; not a guaranteed module bound over all temperatures. ESP32-S3 unloaded VOH specification is not treated as a loaded-VOH guarantee.
motor_pulldowns.placement: At L298N receiver inputs; ENA/ENB always-on jumpers removed

actuator_isolation.scope: Actuator 5 V bus only; controller branch remains powered

boot_button.contact: Normally open, momentary, unlit dry contact
boot_button.connection: GPIO0 to GND_SYS, parallel with the on-board BOOT contact
boot_button.external_rc: No additional pull-up or capacitor selected; retain existing board and firmware bias

L298N.limit: ENA/ENB jumper columns each contain supply and signal contacts; photograph does not assign which contact is the signal. Confirm continuity before choosing a physical footprint.

JZ_MOS.control_holes: Two repeated TRIG contacts and two repeated GND contacts; one controlled channel
JZ_MOS.unresolved: Internal bias, exact MOS parts, current capability, protection and unpowered state
